output.population: 86 human participants, ages 18–58; right-handed native English speakers with no history of neurological/psychiatric illnesses, no hearing impairments, unimpaired or corrected vision, taking no medication
output.summary: Participants completed the NIH Toolbox then watched one of 10 full-length movies during fMRI, in 2-6 runs, plus a T1-weighted anatomical scan. Version 2.0 reprocessed derivatives with AFNI's afni_proc.py.
